tasks.prompt: Read the input file as arbitrary bytes. Convert ASCII lowercase a..z to A..Z, preserving every other byte including NUL, non-UTF-8 and newlines. Write the transformed bytes to the output file.

Split the input file on LF (byte 10). Discard empty segments; preserve every byte in every nonempty segment, including CR and spaces. Write each retained segment followed by exactly one LF, including an unterminated final segment. Do not trim or case-convert.

The input is empty or LF-separated rows x,y of two canonical signed decimal integers in -100000..100000, with exactly one comma per row, no spaces or blank rows. A final LF is optional. For each row, write its sum in canonical decimal followed by LF. Preserve row order.

The input file contains one canonical decimal n in 0..64, with no newline. For i from 0 through n-1, accumulate sum(0..i) and append a row i:sum followed by LF to the output. For n=0 write an empty file.
